## Overview

This report compares the newly submitted dataset to the prior year version.

```{r}
# placeholder: 
current_file = "v023_r2025.csv"

filename <- base::basename(current_file)

match <- stringr::str_match(filename, "^v(\\d+)_r(\\d{4})\\.csv$")

measurenum <- match[,2]
year    <- as.integer(match[,3])

prior_year <- year - 1

prior_file = countyhealthR::get_chrr_measure_data(geography = "county", measure = as.numeric(measurenum))

```
